hack2hire:688a81d832b6b01c49be543b.reference: try every pair (a, b) and keep the lexicographically smallest key (|a - b|, a, b)
hack2hire:688a81d832b6b01c49be543b.candidate_design: two pointers over both sorted lists find the minimum difference d; a second merge pass walks A in ascending order and, for each a, advances a pointer in B to the first value >= a - d, returning the first a for which a - d or a + d is present
